reason: The single support boolean removed output-shape variance but the rubric did not define grade anchors. A defensible all-EXCELLENT least-privilege scorecard was rejected because validators had no shared boundary between adjacent qualitative tiers. Revision V5 adds explicit anchors and one-tier tolerance while retaining exact critical FAIL and NOT_APPLICABLE boundaries.
sanitization: Only deployment identity and allowlisted failure classification fields are retained. Raw receipt, trace, validator configuration, provider output and secrets are excluded.
